evals.prompt: Two ready independent substantial checklist stories; sufficient verified role/model/capacity and existing grants. Execute with an agent team.
evals.expected_output: Sol main session directly dispatches ready workers before waiting and owns integration.
expectations: No custom coordinator or nested manager; explicit Luna workers
Two dispatches before any wait
No duplicate parent manager or tracker
Observed overlap is separate from dispatch compliance

evals.prompt: A and B workers returned patches, but only A has passed integration review and commit. C depends on A and B.
evals.expected_output: Keep C pending until B delivery and a clean base containing both integration commits.
expectations: Worker completion does not release B
Validate prerequisite base ancestry
Preserve completed story evidence

evals.prompt: Normal Sol main can select Luna workers, but spawn lacks native story-reviewer selection. Run a standard substantial batch.
evals.expected_output: Block before worker calls; report exact missing reviewer capability.
expectations: No generic reviewer roleplay
No model substitution or automatic install
Direct orchestration does not cure missing mandatory reviewer capability

evals.prompt: No custom coordinator, primary selector or nesting is available. The Sol main can select Luna workers and the exact required reviewer. Execute the independent approved plan.
evals.expected_output: The Sol main thread dispatches direct Luna workers and retains all Git and task state.
expectations: No child coordinator or proxy-spawning
Native reviewer and shared gates retained
Explicit subdelegation budget not exceeded

evals.prompt: Two ready stories overlap src/ and src/shared.py and use one shared output directory with no exclusion mechanism.
evals.expected_output: Serialize conflicting operations and report why while preserving safe independent work.
expectations: No conflicting writes
No invented lock or automatic service
No automatic worktree isolation claim

evals.prompt: Resume after uncertain worker spawn and a final blocked story review. Start another worker and reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Inspect native sessions and candidate evidence; preserve budget and stop affected story.
expectations: No duplicate possibly-live worker
No refreshed review budget
Material-resolution evidence required

evals.prompt: Prepare a plan only; use a swarm later. Also inspect a RalphJSON request.
evals.expected_output: Do not enter execution; report the missing approved plan or planning-only boundary and keep Ralph serial.
expectations: No execution during planning
No team routing from Ralph
No mandatory manager for simple edits

evals.prompt: All stories are integrated, reviewed and committed, but archival fails before the new plan is written.
evals.expected_output: Preserve state, report closeout pending, and block replacement until required preservation.
expectations: No false archive success
No automatic cleanup retry
No unintegrated completion markers

evals.prompt: Execute a swarm without an approved story plan.
evals.expected_output: Report missing plan input without invoking a planning skill.
expectations: No implicit prepare-implementation invocation
No invented story plan or execution state

evals.prompt: The coordinator is a child and asks to own merging and mark stories complete.
evals.expected_output: Child returns advice only; main session owns direct dispatch, Git, merging and canonical task state.
expectations: No child-owned canonical writes
No proxy-spawning
Preserve existing delivery gates
Only verified main-thread integration delivery releases dependencies

evals.prompt: All stories are committed and verified. Archive automatically under the previously granted closeout scope using the bound tasks/prd-search.md.
evals.expected_output: Invoke the discovered installed archive_run.py with the exact worktree/PRD paths, report actual status and preserve a flat archive.
expectations: No repeated approval request under unchanged authority
No LLM-written copy/remove commands
PRD is alongside plan/progress/memory
No implicit push

evals.prompt: Ralph's last agent reports completion, but its supervisor is still running. Archive the run.
evals.expected_output: Wait for supervisor validation and successful exit; preserve active artifacts.
expectations: No archival inside the final iteration
No removal of plan.json before supervisor validation
No manufactured completion evidence

evals.prompt: Archive an old run with checked boxes but no structured review/check records. The helper failed during source removal; retry cleanup.
evals.expected_output: Report missing evidence or partial state and preserve files pending scoped reconciliation.
expectations: No invented story-result records
No automatic cleanup retry
No replacement of the helper with shell commands

evals.prompt: Continue the next eligible story under the existing explicit sequence implementation/test/delegation/local-commit grant.
evals.expected_output: Carry the existing grant across story boundaries, verifying scope and all delivery safeguards without another activation prompt.
expectations: No repeated approval for unchanged scope
Native Goal and Ralph remain alternative workers
Branch/candidate/review/commit gates preserved

evals.prompt: The normal Sol main session can dispatch directly. An optional coordinator advisor starts its own worker loop.
evals.expected_output: Keep main session as sole dispatcher; reconcile and quiesce competing ownership before proceeding.
expectations: No competing dispatch loops
Main thread owns dispatch, Git and task state
Optional advisor cannot become dispatcher

evals.prompt: Resume an older delegated run with uncertain coordinator outcome. Switch to main-session direct dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Inspect native state; block transfer until coordinator is quiescent and all assignments/reviewer sessions are reconciled.
expectations: No proxy-spawning
No duplicate possibly-live owner
No reset review budget
Direct dispatch needs required worker/reviewer controls; record model evidence or unknowns

evals.prompt: Set /goal for PLAN.md without selecting run-agent-team; assume it activates automatically.
evals.expected_output: Explicitly select the skill through /skills or its discovered skill name; a goal alone does not activate it.
expectations: No custom primary selection
Do not invent combined slash-command parsing
Verify actual execution, worktree and commit scope

evals.prompt: Use run-agent-team in another AI harness whose normal main session exposes authorized native Luna workers, Sol coordination, the exact Astra story-reviewer and same-session continuation.
evals.expected_output: Use the actual native controls and direct main-session orchestration; do not require Codex or its CLI commands.
expectations: No mandatory Codex session or custom primary
Preserve all isolation, capacity, review and delivery gates
Inspect actual host schemas

evals.prompt: Another harness lacks dedicated reviewer selection. Rename a generic worker story-reviewer and proceed.
evals.expected_output: Block the affected native review path with exact missing capability; a label supplies no native role or tools.
expectations: No fake native invocation
No permission bypass or automatic installation
No silent review-budget change

evals.prompt: Execute the approved plan with existing implementation, worktree and commit authority. Coordinator model telemetry is unavailable. The exact native story-reviewer is fixed to Luna and supports same-session continuation. No user model requirement exists; other gates pass.
evals.expected_output: Proceed with the current main session and exact Luna-pinned reviewer; record unknown coordinator model and the preference fallback once.
expectations: No model-only blocker or renewed model approval
No unsupported override, generic reviewer substitution or runtime configuration edit
Preserve exact native role, protocol, checks and bounded review passes

evals.prompt: The user explicitly requires an Astra reviewer. The exact native story-reviewer is fixed to Luna and cannot be overridden.
evals.expected_output: Block the affected path on the explicit user constraint; report the fixed pin without substituting a model or role.
expectations: Skill fallback does not override explicit user requirements
No generic Astra reviewer or automatic installation
Preserve existing candidate and review history

evals.prompt: The native worker API exposes inheritance but no model override. Main-session model telemetry is unknown. All ownership, capacity, reviewer and execution gates are satisfied; there is no explicit user model requirement.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch through the supported API using inheritance, recording unknown effective models and the unavailable preference controls.
expectations: No invented model parameter or capability-probe agents
No repeated preflight on an unchanged model gap
Actual native reviewer and same-session gates remain required

evals.prompt: Resume after the revised model preference policy is activated and the prior dispatcher is quiescent. 26/122 stories are delivered. US-027 has a recovered passing native review and pending commit. Reconcile its unchanged candidate and existing check/review evidence under the existing commit grant.
evals.expected_output: Verify candidate/evidence and session history, preserve consumed passes, then complete pending authorized finalization if every delivery gate still holds.
expectations: No new review solely to change model or renew a passing verdict
No delivery claim before successful commit
No assumed candidate validity from the reported story count
Unrelated blockers and exhausted review budgets remain authoritative

evals.prompt: Held-out: main is verified Astra, implementation workers are fixed to Sol, and the exact native reviewer is fixed to Luna. All required capabilities, grants and cost limits are satisfied. No user model constraint exists.
evals.expected_output: Keep the current coordinator, respect each fixed pin, and proceed under the normal isolation and delivery gates with recorded fallback reasons.
expectations: No Sol coordinator prerequisite
No Luna implementation or Astra reviewer prerequisite
No automatic model switching or role replacement

evals.prompt: A slow SDK verification for candidate A yields with a running command handle. B is independent, substantial, dependency-ready and has a clean prepared base. A safely available worker slot, private outputs and authority are verified; the integration queue is below its limit.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch B before waiting again on the existing SDK command; preserve A and its shared-resource freeze.
expectations: Reassess readiness, ownership, capacity and queue pressure at the yield
Reuse the check handle; no duplicate SDK command or busy polling
A long check alone does not pause isolated work
Report actual check results; dispatch alone does not prove overlap or delivery

evals.prompt: Worker A hands off an adapter that needs substantial bounded source repair. Its original worker is available under the existing budget. The coordinator has a copy of the candidate; no review is active, and unrelated B remains eligible below the queue limit.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile the exact candidate and transfer exclusive source ownership back to A for repair, keeping Git, shared integration files and delivery coordination with the main thread.
expectations: Verify prior writer quiescence and confirm root, revision and owned paths before worker edits
Provide failure evidence and feasible focused rechecks; no simultaneous coordinator edits
Receive actual recheck results and transfer ownership back before integration
Reassess at remediation finish and continue eligible independent work
No expanded delegation, advisor, remediation or review budget

evals.prompt: Worker A discovers its task worktree lacks the shared generated SDK build hook. Focused source tests can run, but compilation needs the integration owner's existing hook. A source-only handoff is necessary.
evals.expected_output: Report the constraint early, run feasible checks and arrange a minimal integration compile checkpoint; explicitly label the handoff unqualified.
expectations: Packet identifies compilation/check commands, required hooks and private output locations
Report passed, failed and unrun checks separately with actual results
No broad build-system duplication, automatic dependency installation or claimed compilation pass
Source-only candidate counts toward queue pressure and cannot release dependencies
Required integrated checks and bounded review still precede delivery

evals.prompt: The recorded queue limit is two with two feasible workers and adequate private storage. A is integrating; B and C await integration, and D is dependency-ready. A previously active worker E hands off while the coordinator is still checking A.
evals.expected_output: Do not dispatch D. Preserve E even though the queue temporarily exceeds two, then prioritize qualification, remediation and delivery until admission is safe.
expectations: Explain the limit using worker capacity and project resources in the existing checkpoint
Distinguish active implementation, awaiting integration, integrating, remediation and review
Count source-only and worker-remediation candidates outside the integration lane
No limit inflation, discarded candidate or live-writer termination to hide saturation
Reassess after review/commit and refill when queue, capacity and resource gates permit

evals.prompt: Session inspection lists idle A, completed B and pending-init C, but the exposed labels do not establish whether they occupy capacity. A confirmed occupied worker can continue safely, and an existing candidate can be integrated. Another spawn would rely on the uncertain slot.
evals.expected_output: Consult documented capacity semantics and supported inspection; distinguish observed occupancy from uncertainty and defer only admission relying on the unconfirmed slot.
expectations: Do not assume any label consumes or releases capacity
No duplicate possibly-live owner, unsupported lifecycle control or pending-work discard
Record the concrete capacity effect and continue safely eligible existing work
No repeated unchanged polling or capability-probe agents

evals.prompt: The exact native reviewer has finished its initial pass with actionable findings. Its session appears idle and the runtime documents that retained sessions occupy slots. The same story may need its single targeted pass; another ready worker would require releasing this reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Retain the reviewer session and its occupied capacity; arrange bounded remediation and the permitted same-session targeted continuation.
expectations: No release, replacement reviewer or new initial pass to gain capacity
Candidate remains frozen during active review; transfer repair ownership only afterward
One initial and at most one targeted pass remain the budget
A review-finished checkpoint does not imply a released slot

evals.prompt: A slow SDK check holds the only supported shared output/resource mechanism. Ready B requires that resource; C depends on A, whose integration commit has not happened. No independently eligible story remains.
evals.expected_output: Serialize B's conflicting operation and keep C pending; record these concrete resource and dependency constraints before waiting.
expectations: No forced occupancy, artificial work splitting or invented lock/service
A yielding check does not by itself authorize conflicting work
Release the resource only when safe under the project mechanism
Dispatch C only from a clean base containing A's verified integration delivery commit

evals.prompt: Held-out combined sequence: two workers hand off while A's SDK check yields; the queue reaches its recorded limit. B needs repair, A's initial review then needs targeted continuation, and the runtime cannot confirm whether C's completed session frees a slot. After authorized A delivery, a dependent becomes ready. Assess decisions through the next handoff and commit, not just the initial dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Walk each event against queue, ownership, capacity, resource and delivery gates; qualify and deliver work while preserving pending candidates and required reviewer continuity.
expectations: Prioritize draining saturated work; transfer bounded B repair without simultaneous writers
Retain A reviewer for permitted targeted continuation; uncertainty is separate from observed occupancy
Reassess on handoff, long-check yield, remediation finish, review finish and commit
Refill only safely eligible capacity after pressure drops; verify dependent base ancestry
Evaluate sustained useful concurrency and verified delivery, not full slot occupancy
Static walkthrough is not a live performance measurement

evals.prompt: A qualified worker candidate needs a tiny integration import fix. Sending it back would cost more coordination than the edit; the main thread owns the candidate and no reviewer is currently reading it.
evals.expected_output: Keep the small fix with the main thread, run affected checks and preserve the normal review/commit gates.
expectations: Do not delegate every fix or introduce another approval gate
Do not reuse stale check/review evidence after the content changes
No extra worker staged review or reset of consumed passes
